title: 36 Hours in Canberra, Australia
abstract: In the country’s capital, situated between Sydney and Melbourne, you’ll find everything from culture to cycling, political history to panoramic views.

title: 36 Hours in Venice
abstract: Sip and snack canalside, indulge in gelato for breakfast and forage for not-so-touristy souvenirs during a weekend in northern Italy.

title: 36 Hours in Madrid
abstract: Shop for handmade shoes and edible souvenirs, sample cocktails and cuisine and go on a cultural crawl during a weekend in the Spanish capital.

title: 36 Hours in Stockholm
abstract: The center of the Swedish capital is lovely and historic, but there are new galleries, boutiques and breweries farther out worth exploring.
